claim_title: Daily creatine slow melanoma tumor growth
caption: **Creatine and melanoma.** One study found daily creatine slowed melanoma tumor growth in mice by boosting the activity of dendritic cells, immune cells that help fight cancer. But the work was done entirely in male mice with a single engineered tumor type, using injected rather than oral creatine, and rests on one small experiment of six mice per group. It did not stop tumors from progressing, and some evidence suggests creatine could also help tumor cells grow — so this cannot yet be applied to people.
subtitle: This rests on one small mouse study using injected, not oral, creatine.
